task_title: Persist Sprite Editor annotations through the asset queue

plan_review.notes: Adopted per-sprite queue-tip merge for the aggregate annotations JSON, serialized saves and fingerprint-guarded cleanup, plus concurrent-writer and rapid-save regression coverage. Rejected whole-file last-writer-wins because it could erase unrelated durable annotations.

independent_grade.notes: Implemented durable queue-backed annotations with robust cross-process JSON key merging. Main worktree index safety is strictly enforced via hasStagedChanges check, bypassing cleanup and retaining local edits on conflict. Out-of-band updates, pending overlays, and fallback scenarios are correctly managed and robust to races. Fully tested via real-git concurrent simulations, with no data loss or unsafe worktree/index behavior observed.
